name: DataCat
upstream: https://github.com/replit/datacat (Apache-2.0), built from commit f08fb63 (no releases yet)

var_descriptions.datacat.DATABASE_URL: Postgres connection string, built from the bundled postgres service
var_descriptions.datacat.PUBLIC_URL: Canonical public HTTPS origin used for invite links and the agent installer; update it if you add a custom domain
var_descriptions.datacat.SESSION_SECRET: Generated key that signs session cookies
var_descriptions.datacat.DATACAT_SETUP_TOKEN: Generated secret the first-run setup page asks for before creating the admin account

title: DataCat (Self-Hosted Observability)
short_desc: Self-hosted metrics, logs and traces dashboard by Replit
icon_note: mdi/chart-timeline-variant (neutral; upstream logo reuse not checked); postgres: devicon postgresql
angle: Replit's brand-new open-source Datadog-style observability stack (3 days old at the time of the build): metrics, logs, APM traces, dashboards and monitors, with OTLP and Datadog-agent-compatible intake, in one container plus Postgres. Zero inputs on Railway: generated session secret and setup token, proxy trust and 15-day retention baked in, ClickHouse intentionally skipped (Postgres storage is the upstream default).
notes: No upstream image or releases, so ghcr.io/onepush-dev/datacat:f08fb63 is built from replit/datacat at commit f08fb63 with the same steps as upstream's Dockerfile (code unmodified). PORT=8080, DATACAT_TRUST_PROXY=1 and DATACAT_RETENTION_DAYS=15 are baked into the image (plain variables are dropped by templates create). Setup token is the DATACAT_SETUP_TOKEN service variable. Telemetry is stored in Postgres (hourly retention cleanup). No volume on datacat: only agent downloads dir (empty). Not affiliated with Replit/DataCat.
